lesson_title: Letters and sounds you already speak
objective: See a home-language vowel letter (a, e, i, o, u) with no audio and choose its sound.
learning_area: Language, Literacy and Communication (home language): pre-literacy
proposed_outcome: Associates the letters of the home-language alphabet with their sounds, starting with the vowels.

lesson_title: Letters and sounds you already speak
objective: Hear a home-language vowel, alone or inside a familiar word, and find its letter.
learning_area: Language, Literacy and Communication: pre-literacy
proposed_outcome: Hears and distinguishes individual sounds in spoken words, including sounds that differ between the home language and English.

lesson_title: Building syllables and reading your first home-language words
objective: Blend a consonant and a vowel into a syllable (ma, ba, mi, bu) and read it with no audio.
learning_area: Language, Literacy and Communication (home language): pre-literacy
proposed_outcome: Blends letters into syllables and reads simple, familiar home-language words.

lesson_title: Building syllables and reading your first home-language words
objective: Read simple, familiar home-language words with no audio and match them to pictures.
learning_area: Language, Literacy and Communication (home language): pre-literacy
proposed_outcome: Blends letters into syllables and reads simple, familiar home-language words.

lesson_title: Building syllables and reading your first home-language words
objective: Build a familiar home-language word from its syllables after hearing it.
learning_area: Language, Literacy and Communication (home language): pre-literacy
proposed_outcome: Blends letters into syllables and reads simple, familiar home-language words.

lesson_title: The same letters in English: what stays the same and what changes
objective: Recognise that letters such as m, s, n and d make similar sounds in the home language and in English.
learning_area: Language, Literacy and Communication: pre-literacy
proposed_outcome: Hears and distinguishes individual sounds in spoken words, including sounds that differ between the home language and English.

lesson_title: The same letters in English: what stays the same and what changes
objective: Recognise letters and letter pairs that sound different in English: click letters, th, and vowels such as u in 'bus'.
learning_area: Language, Literacy and Communication: pre-literacy
proposed_outcome: Hears and distinguishes individual sounds in spoken words, including sounds that differ between the home language and English.

lesson_title: English letter sounds: s, a, t, p
objective: See the letters s, a, t and p with no audio and choose their English sounds.
learning_area: Language, Literacy and Communication: English (additional language)
proposed_outcome: Recognises English letters and associates them with their most common sounds.

lesson_title: English letter sounds: s, a, t, p
objective: Hear the English sounds /s/, /æ/, /t/ and /p/ and find their letters.
learning_area: Language, Literacy and Communication: English (additional language)
proposed_outcome: Recognises English letters and associates them with their most common sounds.

lesson_title: English letter sounds: s, a, t, p
objective: Blend s, a, t and p into short words (at, sat, tap) and read them with no audio.
learning_area: Language, Literacy and Communication: English (additional language)
proposed_outcome: Decodes and understands simple, regularly spelt English words, including words not seen before.

lesson_title: English letter sounds: i, n, m, d (and c)
objective: See the letters i, n, m and d (alone and in short words) and choose their English sounds.
learning_area: Language, Literacy and Communication: English (additional language)
proposed_outcome: Recognises English letters and associates them with their most common sounds.

lesson_title: English letter sounds: i, n, m, d (and c)
objective: Hear the English sounds /ɪ/, /n/, /m/ and /d/ and find their letters.
learning_area: Language, Literacy and Communication: English (additional language)
proposed_outcome: Recognises English letters and associates them with their most common sounds.

lesson_title: English letter sounds: i, n, m, d (and c)
objective: Read the letter c as /k/ in English words, not as a home-language click.
learning_area: Language, Literacy and Communication: English (additional language)
proposed_outcome: Recognises English letters and associates them with their most common sounds.

lesson_title: Tracing and writing your first English letters
objective: Form the lower-case letters t, i, n, p, a and s by tracing in the right stroke order.
learning_area: Language, Literacy and Communication: English (additional language)
proposed_outcome: Forms lower-case letters correctly and writes or types simple words.

lesson_title: Tracing and writing your first English letters
objective: Find and type letters and a short word on the phone keyboard.
learning_area: Language, Literacy and Communication: English (additional language)
proposed_outcome: Forms lower-case letters correctly and writes or types simple words.

lesson_title: Blending three-sound words (cat, sit, map, pen)
objective: Read three-sound words (cat, sit, map, pen) with no audio and show their meaning.
learning_area: Language, Literacy and Communication: English (additional language)
proposed_outcome: Decodes and understands simple, regularly spelt English words, including words not seen before.

lesson_title: Blending three-sound words (cat, sit, map, pen)
objective: Build three-sound words from letter tiles after hearing them.
learning_area: Language, Literacy and Communication: English (additional language)
proposed_outcome: Forms lower-case letters correctly and writes or types simple words.

lesson_title: Blending three-sound words (cat, sit, map, pen)
objective: Hear the difference between English vowel sounds in words (pan / pen, ship / sheep).
learning_area: Language, Literacy and Communication: English (additional language)
proposed_outcome: Listens to and understands simple spoken English words and sentences about familiar topics.

lesson_title: Picture-to-word matching and building words with tiles
objective: Read new three-sound words (man, tin, pan, dad, bus) with no audio and match them to pictures.
learning_area: Language, Literacy and Communication: English (additional language)
proposed_outcome: Decodes and understands simple, regularly spelt English words, including words not seen before.

lesson_title: Picture-to-word matching and building words with tiles
objective: Spell three-sound words with letter tiles.
learning_area: Language, Literacy and Communication: English (additional language)
proposed_outcome: Forms lower-case letters correctly and writes or types simple words.

lesson_title: Picture-to-word matching and building words with tiles
objective: Understand these words when they are spoken.
learning_area: Language, Literacy and Communication: English (additional language)
proposed_outcome: Listens to and understands simple spoken English words and sentences about familiar topics.

lesson_title: Common sight words (the, a, is, I, you)
objective: Recognise and read the high-frequency words the, a, is, I and you on sight.
learning_area: Language, Literacy and Communication: English (additional language)
proposed_outcome: Recognises common high-frequency English words that are not spelt by regular sound rules.

lesson_title: Common sight words (the, a, is, I, you)
objective: Type the words the and you on the phone keyboard.
learning_area: Language, Literacy and Communication: English (additional language)
proposed_outcome: Forms lower-case letters correctly and writes or types simple words.

lesson_title: Reading your first sentences
objective: Read simple sentences (I am at work. The bus is here.) with no audio and show their meaning.
learning_area: Language, Literacy and Communication: English (additional language)
proposed_outcome: Reads and understands short, simple English sentences about familiar situations.

lesson_title: Reading your first sentences
objective: Put the words of a heard sentence in the right order.
learning_area: Language, Literacy and Communication: English (additional language)
proposed_outcome: Builds short, simple English sentences in the correct word order.

lesson_title: Reading your first sentences
objective: Understand short spoken English sentences.
learning_area: Language, Literacy and Communication: English (additional language)
proposed_outcome: Listens to and understands simple spoken English words and sentences about familiar topics.

lesson_title: Reading a simple SMS
objective: Read a short SMS and find key information: who sent it, what it is about, which day and what time.
learning_area: Language, Literacy and Communication: English (additional language)
proposed_outcome: Reads simple functional texts (SMS messages, signs, notices) and finds key information such as who, what, when and where.

lesson_title: Reading a simple SMS
objective: Type a short reply (OK, yes) on the phone keyboard.
learning_area: Language, Literacy and Communication: English (additional language)
proposed_outcome: Writes or types short functional responses, such as a reply to a message or a short answer.

lesson_title: Reading common signs
objective: Read common signs (STOP, EXIT, DANGER, TOILETS, OPEN, CLOSED) with no audio and act on their meaning.
learning_area: Language, Literacy and Communication: English (additional language)
proposed_outcome: Reads simple functional texts (SMS messages, signs, notices) and finds key information such as who, what, when and where.

lesson_title: Reading a job notice
objective: Read a short job notice and answer questions about the job, place, days, time and what to bring.
learning_area: Language, Literacy and Communication: English (additional language)
proposed_outcome: Reads simple functional texts (SMS messages, signs, notices) and finds key information such as who, what, when and where.

lesson_title: Reading a job notice
objective: Type a short written answer to a question about a text.
learning_area: Language, Literacy and Communication: English (additional language)
proposed_outcome: Writes or types short functional responses, such as a reply to a message or a short answer.
